answer: Resistance can live in the time axis rather than stake, graph position, or network fingerprint. Registration requires solving an epoch-seeded verifiable delay function: a sequential, memory-hard chain that parallel hardware cannot accelerate. A ferrous server farm gains nothing — ten thousand puppets demand ten thousand serial waits, and rented delay costs more per identity than an identity ever earns. Honest growth climbs like a vine, one node per interval; fakes accumulate as a reef of stalled chains, burning wall-clock time nobody can buy back in bulk.
